outcome.description: `success` or the code of the failure.

target.description: The user acted on, when the entry is about a user.

assignmentId.description: The teaching assignment an extra lecture is for.

beforeFacultyId.description: Who taught the lecture before the ticket was applied.

lecture.description: The lecture as it is now. Only in the detail of one ticket, never in a list.

lectureId.description: The lecture the ticket changes; for an extra lecture, the one it made, once applied.

substituteFacultyId.description: Who takes the lecture; present for a substitute.

conflictingLectureId.description: The lecture that holds what the ticket needs.

conflictingTicketId.description: The ticket that put that lecture there, when one did.

accountsCreated.description: People who got an account from this import (or would).

notProcessed.description: Rows not reached; run the same file again.

capacity.description: The number of seats, when it was recorded.

fits.description: Whether the kind of room suits the session type asked for; true when none was asked.

accountCreated.description: True when this row's person got their account from this import.

code.description: Why the row has the outcome, for ERROR, SKIPPED and NOT_PROCESSED.

line.description: The line in the file where the row starts; the header is line 1.

extra.description: True when a ticket added the lecture to the weekly timetable.

originalDate.description: The date in the base timetable; present only when the lecture was moved.

originalEndTime.description: The end in the base timetable; present only when the lecture was moved.

originalFacultyId.description: The faculty member of the teaching assignment; present only when a substitute teaches the lecture, whose ID and name are then facultyId and facultyName.

originalStartTime.description: The start in the base timetable; present only when the lecture was moved.

administrator.description: True when the user is an administrator (Super Admin) with a verified address. A hint for showing controls; the backend decides every request.

avatarVersion.description: Changes whenever the avatar does; null when there is none. Use it to refresh a cached image.

avatarsEnabled.description: False when the files module is switched off; then there are no avatars.

filesEnabled.description: False when the files module is switched off; then no feature can keep a file, such as a note's picture.

name.description: The name to show; never an email address.

attachmentVersion.description: Changes whenever the picture does; null when there is none. Use it to refresh a cached image.

policyDecided.description: Decided per record, held only through a role that applies within a scope

Problem.description: An RFC 9457 problem. Match on `code`, not on the text.

errors.description: Present for validation failures: one entry per invalid field.

traceId.description: The trace of the request, for support.

reviewerName.description: The reviewer's name; absent when the account is gone.

capacity.description: The capacity to name when asking this person: HOD, CR, BR or AFFECTED_FACULTY.

scopeType.description: GLOBAL or a kind of place; absent for a platform role

roomCode.description: The room's code; absent when it is online or the room was deleted.

authorName.description: The author's name; absent when the account is gone.

batchCode.description: Batch code of a lab or tutorial; absent for theory.

change.description: The first change: the only one of most tickets, and for an exchange the one about the author's own lecture.

changes.description: Every change the ticket makes, in order: one, or two for an exchange.

expiresAt.description: When the earliest lecture it involves starts; a ticket not yet applied lapses then.

facultyName.description: Name of the teacher the lecture had when the ticket was raised.

revertedByTicketId.description: The revert that undid this ticket; present once it is reverted.

revertsTicketId.description: The applied ticket this one undoes; present on a revert.

reviews.description: Who was asked to review it, of every revision, oldest first; empty in a list.

subjectCode.description: Subject code of the lecture's teaching assignment; absent when it was deleted.

importId.description: Names the run in the audit log; null for a dry run.

avatarVersion.description: Changes whenever the avatar does; null when there is none.

erasureBegun.description: True once erasing a deleted user has begun.

name.description: The name to show; never an email address.

info.description: Everything lives under /api/v1. Every call needs a user's bearer token; browsers reach the API only through the Next.js server. Errors are RFC 9457 Problem Details with a stable `code`, the `traceId` of the request and, for validation failures, `errors`.
